snippet.title: How 6 Huge Streamers Spent Their First Day in GTA 6

chapter each, with their real reactions. Plus the viral clips that followed: Bigfoot, Mandy, a UFO abduction, a dog and a car door, and four stars on the beach.

Which streamer had the best first day?

5:39 Chapter 5: xQc
6:29 Chapter 6: DarkViperAU
7:23 The reactions kept coming: Bigfoot, Mandy, Watkins
